decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter builds directly on the firm's core track-lighting and product-engineering know-how, and it was presented as a flagship, so the firm can interpret its results and keep refining it within its existing system.
The LED luminaire line fits the firm's lighting expertise, but LED luminaire lines from 2018 turn over quickly and later LED families (E, F) may replace it, so keeping it is only a modest call.

The home automation server box depends on IT and smart-home knowledge further from the firm's luminaire core, and fast-moving standards make its 2018 hardware likely obsolete, so the firm cannot easily absorb what is needed to improve it.
The luminaire family had its own page and draws on the firm's design and lighting competence, so it remains a natural part of the core range even as newer families arrive.
